title: Hannah's Hotel Meltdown Ends VERY Badly
description:
Police officers in Crystal Lake, Illinois responded to a 911 call from the concierge at a hotel. Hannah Sheppard apparently had trouble getting into her room and took it out on the man at the front desk. When officers arrived, Hannah made it clear she had a problem with her stay so far and asked the officers, whom she knew from a prior arrest, to help her. Hannah took things from 0 to 100 very fast once in her hotel room. Watch the full bodycam footage of Hannah Sheppard.
